Episode Notes:
Collin sits down with Rick Crandall, an Air Force veteran, longtime Denver radio host, and the voice behind Wings Over the Rockies, the Air and Space Museum’s Behind the Wings podcast. Drawing on decades behind the microphone and thousands of interviews, Crandall reflects on what it takes to tell a good story and why the best ones come from learning to listen. The conversation turns to the people behind the machines, the veterans whose accounts have stayed with him, and how the country’s relationship with those who served has shifted across generations.
